notes: The table prints the same three-column block three times side by side (0-3 %, 4-7 % and 8-10 %) instead of one continuous pair of columns. All nine columns are transcribed with the block headings repeated.

In the third block the heading 'Sludge solids (%)' and the values 8, 9 and 10 are printed inside one merged cell with no internal rules; the values are placed on their printed row positions and pair with 33/60, 29/55 and 25/48. The fourth row of the third block prints no values.
Capitalisation 'Raw Sludge' and 'Digested Sludge' is retained.
No Source line is printed for this table; the 'Source: Metcalf & Eddy' line below belongs to Figure 6.2.
Printed title reads 'Hazen Williams' without a hyphen; retained.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All nine columns and four rows read from a 600 dpi crop of the block, including a second crop of the third block to establish that its solids values sit inside one merged cell.
